name: 10x Xenium cell type annotation benchmark
description: Assesses cell type annotation methods specifically on 10x Genomics Xenium spatial transcriptomics data to compare accuracy and robustness.
reputation: Niche benchmark used by the computational biology community for evaluating cell type annotation on 10x Xenium spatial transcriptomics data.
notes: Platform-specific (Xenium) biases and batch effects can affect results; dataset and tasks are domain-specific and not intended for general LLM evaluation.
